title: Smiling Couple Ike & Dot, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid mid-1940s black-and-white snapshot featuring a happy couple outdoors on a dirt road surrounded by tall pine trees. The woman laughs naturally in a heavy wool overcoat with a era-typical styled hair, standing next to her partner dressed in a suit. The deckle-edged photograph captures everyday mid-century life. Handwritten on the reverse in ink is 'Ike & Dot'.
